summary: Master No-Code AI Automation with Zapier, Make, and Power Automate. Build AI agents, optimize workflows, and scale automation. Enroll in our 5-day intermediate
lede: No-Code AI Automation with Zapier, Make and Power Automate teaches you to build intelligent workflows through visual interfaces instead of traditional coding. You will learn to map processes into triggers, actions, conditions and data paths while connecting business apps and AI models. The course covers multi-step automations, AI agents, AI Co-pilots, custom forms, chatbots, caching, batching and execution-log optimization. You will also explore governance controls and the Model Context Protocol as you develop practical automation skills for complex systems, limited budgets and rapid deployment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to automate business processes without coding skills, leveraging visual development tools to drive operational efficiency.
audience: Business Analyst - Map processes and design
Sales Team Lead - Automate customer touchpoints
Marketing Specialist - Create automated content distribution
Data Entry Specialist - Eliminate repetitive data
modules: Foundations of No-Code Automation and AI Integration
Building Multi-Step Workflows with AI Models
Scaling Automation with Governance and Compliance
Advanced Features: Forms, Tables, and Canvas
Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Advanced AI Servers
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of common business applications (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, CRM systems). No programming or coding skills are required. Participants must bring a laptop with internet access to access cloud-based platforms (Zapier, Make, Power Automate) during hands-on labs. A free account for Zapier and Make is recommended but not mandatory as training accounts will be provided.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
